commit.message:
daemon(1490): an accepted stop reaches the step before the session opens and across a restart (#1495)

A stop the daemon fetched while the step's runStep was still preparing
(workspace prepare, setup hooks, team skills, or createSession in flight)
was dropped. fetchStop had already deleted stop_pending, deliverStop found
no entry in sessionHandles, logged "stop dropped (no live session)", and
the session then opened and ran to success. The verify-step-claim model
(P4) found two more ways to the same end: with two runs of one step on a
machine only the newest session handle got the stop, and a daemon restart
after the stop re-ran the step from its journal.

After #1473 a step runs at most once per machine, so the per-step set of
stop slots and the fan-out delivery only served a state that can no
longer occur. StepStops now keeps one RunStop per step id, and the slot
writes and clears the journal mark itself, so deliverStop is fetch, look
up, deliver.

A run that holds a stop before its session opens no longer has its own
report path. The session loop breaks before opening a session and the
normal tail runs: discard rewind, transcript upload, done(stopped). On
restart a journaled stop is passed into runStep instead of being
reported directly, so discard now rewinds the worktree on that path too;
the separate reportStopped and resumeStoppedStep helpers are gone. The
interrupt at attach no longer blocks the stream watchdogs.

Tests share one stoppable backend and a defer() helper from the harness,
deliver through the same RunStop.deliver call as production, and drop
the two-runs case that #1473 made unreachable. The model's recover step
now starts a halted executor; all four properties pass.

The loop-top stop check ran before the pass state reset, so a stop that
landed during the network-retry wait kept the failed round's sawDone and
lastError and the step reported failed. The check now runs after the
reset. Adds a test for that window and one for the recover discard
rewind, which had no coverage.

closes #1490
